title: Structure
description: Domains, modules and lessons: the path learners follow, in the order shown here.

tree.emptyDomain: No modules in this domain yet.

orphans.notice: Some items are not filed anywhere
orphans.lessons_one: {{count}} lesson is not in any module.
orphans.lessons_other: {{count}} lessons are not in any module.
orphans.noDomainHint: These modules do not appear in any domain. Attach them with “Change domain”.
orphans.lessonsHint: Attach them to a module from the Lessons screen so they appear in the learning path.

empty.title: The structure is empty
empty.description: Create a first domain, or import the TACTIC syllabus to create domains, modules and lessons in one go.

error.title: The structure could not be loaded
error.body: Check your connection, then try again.

domainForm.description: A domain groups several modules around one broad subject.
domainForm.emoji: Emoji shown in the mobile app
domainForm.emojiHint: Optional. Not shown in the admin.
domainForm.name: Domain name
domainForm.objectiveHint: Optional. What the learner can do at the end of the domain.
domainForm.exists: A domain with this name already exists.

moduleForm.description: A module groups the lessons that answer the same question.
moduleForm.emoji: Emoji shown in the mobile app
moduleForm.name: Module name
moduleForm.nameEnHint: Optional. Shown when the app is in English.
moduleForm.coreQuestionHint: The question the module answers. For example: “How do I avoid running out of money before payday?”
moduleForm.themeHint: Optional. The subject the module's lessons share, for example “Student budget”.
moduleForm.exists: A module with this name already exists.
moduleForm.emojiHint: Optional. Not shown in the admin.

move.title: Change domain
move.description: Choose the domain for “{{name}}”. Its lessons stay in the module.

deleteDomain.title: Delete the domain “{{name}}”?
deleteDomain.body_one: Its module will move to “No domain”, with its lessons. No module or lesson is deleted.
deleteDomain.body_other: Its {{count}} modules will move to “No domain”, with their lessons. No module or lesson is deleted.

deleteModule.title: Delete the module “{{name}}”?
deleteModule.body_one: Its lesson will be detached and listed under “Lessons without a module”. It is not deleted.
deleteModule.body_other: Its {{count}} lessons will be detached and listed under “Lessons without a module”. They are not deleted.
deleteModule.resources: Library resources linked to this module will no longer be attached to it.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.body: What you typed will not be saved.
